answer: Persistent Operator Liability Ledger. Each new identity must be seeded by an existing operator whose ledger balance covers it; the operator posts a vine of linked registrations traceable to their root. If any linked identity is caught sybil-clustering, the operator's entire ledger is frozen and future registrations blocked. The falcon flag on the root account triggers a crystal audit trace, forcing the operator to reveal full registration history or forfeit all linked balances.
